description: APEX converts geographic positions into several geomagnetic coordinate systems. Its Fortran routines use a reference magnetic field and provide coordinate transforms and associated geometric quantities. The resource is documented by UCAR. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. This is a supporting numerical transformation, not a complete infrastructure-impact simulator. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
